categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches `src/i2p.cpp` to adjust SAM bridge connection establishment for I2P peer connectivity and AddrMan reachability accounting.
categories.rationale: Eliminating the redundant SAM bridge lookup removes latency and fixes an issue where unresolvable peers were misclassified as internal proxy errors rather than reachability failures. While useful for I2P connection reliability and AddrMan failure tracking, the issue is not critical to network health or node security.
